timing: After one successful engineering pilot; before any complete 22-hull campaign. Earlier protocols remain immutable.
new_mathematical_target: Extend the certified minimax lower bound to every prediction function through two indistinguishable admissible signals; combine with the reproducing linear estimator upper bound to prove an exact necessary-and-sufficient uniform recovery radius.
scope: Uniform worst-case guarantee over all real polynomial coefficients and all coordinatewise bounded response errors at the fixed design. Does not assert local or average-case optimality, stochastic coverage, correctness of the physical model, known instrument precision, or superiority over learned methods with extra assumptions.
